values.note: Pull-through sites with 30/50-amp and water, or 30-amp and water ('Partial Hook Up'); both include free dump-station use. No sewer at the sites is advertised.

Pull through sites with 30 /50 Amp with Water. Free Dump Station Use', '30 Amp Partial Hook Up Sites ... Pull through sites with 30 Amp and water, Free Dump Station Use'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: All sites pull-through: the 30/50-amp sites up to 100 ft long, the 30-amp sites up to 60 ft.

sites.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260306181825/https://lewisandclarkrvpark.com/ (operator's page: 'Pull through sites ... Sites up to 100 ft long', 'Pull through sites ... Sites up to 60 ft long'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Private restrooms/showers for guests (no coins). Laundry 3 washers/3 dryers. Starlink Wi-Fi at all RV sites. Dump station $10, free for guests. Propane sold. Fenced off-leash dog area.

facilities.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260306181825/https://lewisandclarkrvpark.com/ (operator's page, Services: 'Private Restrooms / Showers Available for park guest only', 'Laundry Room is available', 'Our store provides a variety of items', 'High speed Starlink Wifi Available at all RV sites', 'RV Dump Station $10 Free for guests of the park', 'Propane $3.50 per gal.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Operator (early 2026): 'WE ARE NOW CLOSED FOR THE 2025 SEASON. FALL HOURS: BY APPOINTMENT ONLY' and 'We will still be opening in March for 2026 seasons.' No closing date posted.

'For 2026 Reservations use the Contact us link at the bottom of the page or give us a call.' Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.; after-hours check-in available. Stay 6 nights, get the 7th free. Monthly rates for contract workers ('sorry we don't do residential').

note: Private RV park at Shelby (I-15 Exit 364), ~72 mi E of Glacier NP's east entrance and 34 mi S of the Canadian border; across the street from Lake Shel-Oole and the Roadrunner Recreation Trail, 1.5 mi from downtown. --Claude
summary: Read from a 2026-03-06 archive of the operator's site (live site unreachable here). Confirmed 50-amp electric, water, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/store, 2026 rates $40-45 incl. 8% tax (fees left as recorded, human-checked 2026-10-16; under the $50 gate). Cleared derived sewer (sites are power + water 'partial hook up' with free dump use). Added dump, Wi-Fi, seasonal (opens in March, closed by fall), reservations by phone/contact form. Not stated: site count 60 (left). Note trimmed of restated values and the incorrect 'full-hookup'.
